title: Johns Hopkins president rumored on MJ-12 doing NHI autopsies

tellings.quote: but he was also president of John's Hopkins who is rumored to be on this quote unquote majestic 12 and do autopsies on non-human intelligence bodies.

plain: A scientist named Detlev Bronk, who was president of Johns Hopkins University, is rumored to have sat on Majestic 12, a supposed secret group said to have handled crashed UFOs, and to have performed autopsies on the bodies of non-human intelligence, meaning beings that are not human. Michels raises it himself and calls it a rumor, without naming where it comes from. If true, it would put a major university president at the centre of a hidden study of alien bodies.
